purpose: Select the next V4 performance target after RTDBSCAN no-go and after auditing V2.14 per-app primitive routes.

selection_result.why: Every plausible existing benchmark app either already had the relevant primitive route in V2.14, failed current app-level bars, was rejected as app-identity/deferred, or has no current V4 route. Selecting one as a clean new V4 speed target would repeat the partner/productization-as-performance error.

rejected_existing_targets.reason: Goal4670/4671 no-go: best true grouped-union probe remains below 1.20x and V2.14 already had fixed-radius count-threshold plus grouped-union routes.
V2.14 already had prepared RTDL/OptiX any-hit collision flags and scalar count. Existing V4 any-hit evidence can only support a same-primitive improvement experiment, not a clean new V4 win.
Goal4669 shows V4/V2.14 regression, and V2.14 already used RAY_TRIANGLE_PRIMITIVE_GROUPED_I64_REDUCTION_3D.
Goal4669 shows V4/V3.0.2 regression, and the V2.14 serious row already used ray_triangle_weighted_any_hit_sum_3d.
Goal4669 shows parity, and V2.14 already used prepared AABB index query.
Goal4660/4661 serious rows are parity/slower, and V2.14 already had prepared ranked-summary aggregate.
Already the single true V4 app candidate win in Goal4669; it cannot serve as the second independent win.

Potential true lever would be aggregate-tree fused weighted-vector traversal, but prior V4 inventory and reviews reject the existing implementation for V4.0 as Barnes-Hut/N-body-specific and CUDA-only, not a generic RT-core Tier-2 operator.
Current V4 has no route; V2.14 used mixed explicit Numba/OptiX primitives. A V4 target would first need a new generic relation-topology operator and protocol.
V2.14 already had bounded witness collect and AABB broadphase primitives. A V4 target would require a new full generic contact route or material bounded-collect improvement, not current evidence.

required_before_coding: name the generic operator or same-primitive improvement target
prove whether V2.14 already had the same primitive route
state whether the goal is new-runtime-lever or same-primitive improvement
freeze V2.14, V3.0.2, and V4 denominators
freeze numeric material-speed bar before running
prove the operator is not app-identity
record why partner migration cannot count
allowed_target_classes: new generic relation/topology operator for spatial_rayjoin-like workloads
new generic contact/witness pipeline that goes beyond V2.14 bounded collect-k
material same-primitive improvement over V2.14 for an existing primitive, with V2.14 as the explicit denominator
re-audited hierarchical aggregate operator only if algorithmic genericity and device-input gates pass; existing aggregate-tree fused weighted-vector implementation does not pass as-is
forbidden_target_classes: robot_collision clean-new-win claim without same-primitive V2.14 denominator
partner certification or front-door cleanup counted as speed
fixing 0.98x parity/regression rows as the whole V4 performance story

goal_level_decision_audit.stupid_action: The stupid path was to keep searching for a convenient existing app target after the V2.14 audit showed the plausible candidates mostly reuse V2.14 primitives.
goal_level_decision_audit.alternative_path: Declare that no clean existing app target qualifies, then require Goal4673 to design or select a real new generic runtime lever or a material same-primitive improvement with V2.14 as denominator.

next_action: Goal4673 must not run POD yet. It must first choose one new generic runtime lever or same-primitive improvement target under the candidate gate above.
